summary: Backend and frontend testing completed for Tile Orders UX Restoration on live preview. Backend tile-order workflow regressions passed fully (release -> godown -> dispatch -> chalan/pdf -> movement register). Frontend desktop/tablet/mobile checks passed for dense grids, navigation, release/customer/dispatch/material tabs, and core live action flows; one recurring network abort was captured in browser logs outside Tile Orders core actions.

ui_bugs.issue: Columns labeled DISPATCHED and DELIVERED currently render the same field value (boxes_dispatched), so they are visually indistinguishable in UI.

integration_issues.issue: Browser automation repeatedly captured request failure: POST /api/followups/reconcile -> net::ERR_ABORTED during navigation. Tile Orders APIs continued to work, but this is still a visible network error in logs.

action_items: Investigate and suppress/handle aborted POST /api/followups/reconcile request during route changes so production console/network logs stay clean.
If business expects distinct lifecycle values, map DELIVERED column to a dedicated delivered counter/event source instead of mirroring dispatched.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/app/(admin)/tiles/orders/[id].tsx currently renders both DISPATCHED and DELIVERED from item.boxes_dispatched.

Tile Orders core API bindings and route contracts remain intact: frontend/src/api/tileOrders.ts aligns with backend/routes/tile_orders.py for release/godown/dispatch/movements/dispatch-list endpoints.
Workflow rail is present on dashboard, brand release page, and customer detail page as required.
seed_data_creation: Regression tests created isolated TEST_ quotations/orders through live API flows (including TEST_restore_<uuid> and TEST_pytest_order_created_regression) for persistence and workflow verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use owner credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Mutating mobile UI run successfully executed Move to Godown and Dispatch from Godown on Task19 MultiSupplier Test before timing out on a post-action navigation wait; verify same flow with longer wait and confirm movement register row appears immediately in UI.
rca_of_issue: RCA 1 (network abort): POST /api/followups/reconcile is triggered in background after login and can be aborted when user navigates rapidly (login -> Tile Orders), producing requestfailed logs without breaking Tile Orders flow. RCA 2 (delivered column): UI data mapping in customer table duplicates dispatched into delivered, so separate delivered state is not currently represented visually.
